title: EvolutionX v7.0 on MI 11X Android 13 Official Beta, First Boot
blurb: EvolutionX v7.0 landed as an official beta for the MI 11X, and it's built on Android 13.
video_description:
EvolutionX v7.0 landed as an official beta for the MI 11X, and it's built on Android 13. This is the first boot, the setup and what the ROM feels like before you commit to flashing it.

📱 Device  : MI 11X
🧩 ROM     : EvolutionX v7.0 (Official Beta)
🤖 Android : 13

🔬 What I Checked
• First boot time and how the setup wizard behaves
• Whether the Android 13 notification and quick settings layout arrived intact
• Theme engine and the parts EvolutionX is known for
• Gesture navigation and the usual system smoothness
• Whether the camera app opens and shoots, since that's where custom ROMs fall over
• Basic stability over the first hours, because a beta is a beta

📊 Verdict
Android 13 on the MI 11X feels like Android should. Clean, quick, no junk. EvolutionX keeps the good parts of Pixel software and adds just enough of its own settings without burying you. It's an official beta, so the honest warning is that betas move fast and the odd build can regress. For a daily driver I'd keep a stable ROM zip nearby. Camera quality is the part that always depends on the maintainer, so test it yourself before you make this your only phone.

⚠️ What Beta Means Here
• Features can change or vanish between builds
• Some banking and DRM apps may detect an unlocked bootloader
• Dirty flashing over an older build can cause bootloops, clean flash when in doubt

📝 If You Want to Flash It
1. Unlock the bootloader and install a compatible recovery.
2. Back up system and data first.
3. Wipe system, data, cache and dalvik.
4. Flash the ROM zip, then wipe cache and dalvik.
5. Reboot and let the first boot finish on its own.

❓ Common Questions
Q. Is this official? Yes, it's an official beta build.
Q. Does it need GApps? Flash it the way the release post tells you, don't assume.
Q. Can I roll back to Android 12? Yes, with a clean flash of the older build.
